div.head: Episc 15
div.ab: Et ideo opus est ut eis parcamus qui nobis parere debent; et tunc manutenebimur [in] Dei omnipotentis iudicio. Amen.
[Þ]y we agan þearfe, þæt we ðam beorgan þe us scylan hyran; þonne gebide we þe mare gebeorh æt Godes agenum dome.
Þy we agan þearfe þæt we ðam beorgan þe us scylan hyran; þonne gebide we þe mare gebeorh æt Godes agenum dome.
Darum haben wir nöthig, dass wir derer schonen, die uns gehorchen müssen: dann erwarten wir umsomehr Schutz bei Gottes eigenem Gericht.
Therefore we need to spare those who must obey us: then we may expect all the more protection at God's own judgment.
Accordingly, we have an obligation to protect those compelled to serve us; then we may experience a greater protection at God's own judgment.
div.note: The initial was left out for the rubricator in X. In X a further chapter (Bisceopes dægweorc) follows; in the Quadripartitus, Norðleod follows.
Þy: y with a preceding space for a rubricated initial X
